content: SHIPPED — automatic L3->L2->L1 degrade ladder + assurance manifest (§6 'the gate degrades, it never blocks'). degrade.rs run_ladder: L3 Proved->L3; Timeout->attempt L2 (lower_l2+run_kani); L2 Verified->L2+lowered-assurance+bound; L2 UnderBound->L1 (records level); COUNTEREXAMPLE at any rung->HARD FAIL (never degraded). Composes #11 (timeout-vs-counterexample trigger), #9 (L2 Kani), l1 (L1). manifest.rs: Level: Ord (L0<L1<L2<L3), AssuranceManifest::aggregate = min-over-functions; a hard-failed fn -> project Failed (not a rung). Loop: doc-author -> builder -> critic (found #51) -> fixer. #51: is_under_bound_failure had an over-broad '|| d.contains("unwind")' arm matching a real counterexample whose ens text contains 'unwind' (e.g. unwind_count) -> wrongly degraded to L1, hiding a bug (R-DEFER-9 anti-cheat failure); FIXED to 'unwinding assertion' boilerplate only. Anti-cheat verified: counterexample never degrades (hermetic panic-closure test + live broken-contract -> L0 hard-fail); genuine under-bound still -> L1. Commits 2323dcb -> 36cab43 (critic) -> de890e1 (#51). workspace 288 tests, clippy/fmt clean, corpus L3 no-degrade. Proof-repair loop is #18. Not pushed.
